name: Variety Show
description: Come watch your friends: Sing, Dance, Act and more!! Dress Rehearsal for those participating in the show is on Thursday, March 19th at 4:00pm.

name: Hicklebee's Book Fair
description: The Hicklebee's Book Fair is coming to Los Alamitos! Every spring, our PTA is thrilled to host a second book fair to promote summer reading. This year, we're delighted to continue our partnership with our local children's bookstore, Hicklebee's, who will generously provide the books for our fair. The Book Fair will run from Tuesday, March 24th to Thursday, March 26th, from 8:30 AM to 3:00 PM in the Library. There will be a special Family Night on Tuesday, March 24th, from 5:00 PM to 7:00 PM.

name: Multicultural Fair
description: This year's Multicultural Fair will take place on Friday April 24th from 4-7pm. A beloved tradition at this school, we once again invite you to share your culture with us, whether it's helping with your country's booth (or starting one if it isn't represented yet!), fashion show, or with a group cultural performance.

name: ELA - CAT/PT Testing
description: ELA - CAT/PT Testing for grades 3-5 will take place from April 20th - 24th.

name: Math CAT/PT Testing
description: Math CAT/PT Testing for grades 3-5 will take place from April 27th - May 1st.

name: CAASPP Smarter Balanced Assessments for ELA/Math
description: Students in grades 3-8 and 11 take these computer-based assessments that test the California Common Core State Standards.

name: CAASPP California Science Test (CAST)
description: Students in grade 5 and once in high school take this computer-based assessment that tests the California Next Generation Science Standards.

description: The PTA Art Vista Show will take place.

name: Gold Rush (4th Grade)
description: The 4th grade Gold Rush event will take place.

name: Colonial Day (5th Grade)
description: The 5th grade Colonial Day event will take place.

name: Last Day of School
description: The last day of school is a minimum day, with students dismissed at 12:06pm. It is also Aloha Day, where students can wear Hawaiian attire.

name: Yearbook Order Deadline
description: The last day to order the 2025-2026 Yearbook is April 20th.

name: Yearbook Cover Contest (5th Grade)
description: 5th grade students can enter their drawings for the yearbook cover contest. Entries are due by February 23, 2026.

name: Hidden Villa Farms Field Trip
description: The kindergarten class will be going on a field trip to Hidden Villa Farms. PARENTS: A second permission slip went home this week that needs to be returned by next Monday. Bring a disposable, home packed lunch.

name: Teacher & Staff Appreciation Week
description: Teacher & Staff Appreciation Week will take place from May 4th - 8th.

name: Open House
description: Open House will take place from 5:00pm - 6:00pm.

name: Family Fun Night at BJ's
description: Show this flyer for dine-in and take-out and enter code MAR580 for online orders, and 20% will go to the PTA!

name: NOWRUZ (IRANIAN NEW YEAR) STAFF LUNCHEON
description: Please join us as we treat our staff to a delicious luncheon to celebrate the upcoming Iranian New Year and the first day of spring!

name: Pioneer Crab Feed
description: Come hungry (and thirsty!) to the Pioneer High School Athletics 2026 Crab Feed. It's an all-you-can-eat + all-you-can-drink night that keeps the fun (and the cracking!) going.

name: Uniform Closet Organization
description: The front office is in need of two volunteers to help organize the uniform closet during the minimum days we have in March (12th and 13th) after school.

name: Incoming 2025/26 Castillero 6th Grade Parents
description: Castillero PTA is looking for incoming 6th grade parents to serve on the board. Castillero PTA funds and/ or runs events and programs like school dances, carnival, spirit wear, teacher and staff appreciation, and teacher grants.

name: Reading Lab Volunteers Needed
description: The Reading Lab is a tutoring program for students who would benefit from extra help with fundamental reading skills. We are looking for volunteers who can come in once per week (Tuesday, Wednesday, or Thursday) during the school year. Training for new tutors is provided!!

name: Yearbook Photo Submissions
description: We are looking for photos from PTA events this year! If you have photos from events like Spirit Days, Dandy Day, Bubblefest, Science-o-rama, and Dances, please upload them to the designated Google Drive folders. 5th grade parents — start gathering those adorable baby photos for the 5th Grade Baby Pages! They are due by March 31st!

name: PTA Board Positions for 2026-27
description: We are looking for members of our Los Alamitos community to join our PTA Executive Board for 2026-27 school year! More details about specific positions will be shared soon, but if you're interested in getting involved, please email us or connect with any of our current board members.
